name: sidereus-change
title: 변경 — Sidereus viewer
rules:
Repo: this repository (the folder holding AGENTS.md). AGENTS.md rules override this prompt.
NEVER restart the viewer, NEVER commit/stash/checkout/reset/add, NEVER run screen_check --update. The orchestrator does those.
Other implementers edit other files in the same tree at the same time: touch only your own files, Edit only on existing files, re-read before each edit.

stages.title: 요구사항
stages.task: The orchestrator itself writes R1..Rn checkable criteria plus one Non-goal for the request, following the requirements skill; the owner confirms once before 설계 is dispatched. No subagent.

stages.title: 설계
stages.task: Write the spec for the request: summary, rules affected, tests, screen expectations, risk. Put them in summary. Read-only. Consume the request's R1..Rn criteria; each slice names the R ids it covers; tests cite R ids.

stages.title: 구현
stages.task: Implement your slice only. Report the files you changed; put anything outside your slice in findings.

stages.title: 검증
stages.task: Run the gate once and report each failing step as a finding with file/line. Do not fix anything.

stages.title: 리뷰
stages.task: Review the working-tree diff (git diff + untracked files) against AGENTS.md rules, security and simplicity. status FAIL only for blocking findings (file/line/rule + fix in text); put non-blocking notes in summary.

stages.title: 재검증
stages.task: Run the gate once after the review fix round and report. Do not fix anything.

stages.title: 라이브 검증
stages.task: Report each R line as PASS/FAIL + one piece of evidence (screen crop, test name or file:line).
